ignoreValues.reason: nav-indicator is a single absolutely-positioned decorative pill (not in document flow); animating its width doesn't cause the layout thrash this rule targets, and a scaleX-transform alternative would distort its rounded capsule ends into ellipses mid-animation

stack-col (Tech Stack grid variant) pads whichever edge actually carries a border in each media-query state (16px left on desktop, 16px top on mobile) via mutually-exclusive @media rules; the detector appears to statically combine both rules and see a zero-padding axis that never coexists with its matching border at runtime
lightbox-img is an empty inside a hidden dialog template; openLightbox() in v2.js always sets a real src before removing [hidden], so it never renders empty
